facts.fact: The IPDCP, with a President in office, was acting on 18 November 2026 as the data protection authority, according to its own release.
The IPDCP says it trained data protection correspondents from June 2026, assessed them on 30 September and 1 October, and certified the first 28 on 18 November 2026, for three-year certificates.

note: Names no law, its standing or regulations.
